items.question: How do executive search firms win new mandates?
items.answer: By reaching leadership teams while a hiring need is live, with outreach about the roles and sectors you place in rather than a broad recruiting pitch. For an executive search firm this produced 19 qualified conversations and 4 active mandates, and a UK engineering recruiter booked 23 meetings that led to 4 authorised searches.

items.question: How is this different from job boards and referrals?
items.answer: Job boards and referrals are reactive, you wait for someone to post a role or a contact to think of you. We run proactive outbound to HR Heads and TA Leads at companies showing real hiring signals, so you are in front of decision-makers before they even post the job.

items.question: We already have a business development person. Will this overlap?
items.answer: No. We plug into your existing motion and focus purely on ABM style cold email and LinkedIn outreach to net new client companies. Your BD person keeps managing relationships and closing, we add the top of funnel volume they do not have time to generate.

items.question: Does this integrate with our ATS or CRM?
items.answer: We don't build or manage ATS or CRM integrations, whether that's Bullhorn, Zoho Recruit, or anything else, that stays part of your own process. Every qualified meeting and reply is handed off to your team directly, so it's easy to log wherever you already track pipeline.

items.question: How fast will we start seeing meetings?
items.answer: Most staffing clients see their first qualified client conversations in weeks 3 to 4. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building and sequences are ready. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, as messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: What if the leads are not a good fit for our specialisation?
items.answer: We refine your ICP together in the first two weeks, narrowing by industry, role type and company size, and keep adjusting targeting based on who books calls and who converts. Hiring signals, such as open roles in your specialisation, help focus outreach on companies with a live need.
